split.groups: Exact tuples of all four modeled input fields, excluding the label
split.intent: Approximately 80/20, with class stratification best-effort under group constraints; repeated modeled inputs never cross splits.

preprocessing: Numeric passthrough; OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore,sparse_output=False) fitted only on training rows. No imputation.
selection_rule: One configuration, first fixed fold, no test-set tuning or seed/fold search; metrics reported before frontend integration.
artifact_rule: Persist the exact training-fold pipeline; no refit on held-out records.
feature_choice: Exclude age, gender and hostel from this optional preparation signal; not a claim of validated fairness.
